newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LEADERS LIVERPOOL BEATEN 1-0 AT CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEADERS LIVERPOOL BEATEN 1-0 AT CHELSEA.

text.p: A solitary goal from Roberto di Matteo was enough to give Chelsea a 1-0 win over English premier league leaders Liverpool on Wednesday, and with Arsenal and Newcastle both winning, the gap at the top of the table has again been narrowed.
Arsenal beat Middlesbrough 2-0 to go back into second place, two points behind Liverpool with a game in hand. Ian Wright scored Arsenal's second -- his 200th league goal.

Alan Shearer scored the first premier league goal of 1997, slamming home a rebound after just four minutes against Leeds. He added a second in the 77th minute and Les Ferdinand scored a late third to ensure a 3-0 victory for Newcastle, a result which takes them into fourth.
Champions Manchester United were playing Aston Villa later in the day. Fifth-placed Wimbledon's match at Southampton was postponed due to a frozen pitch.
